memories.text: Release notes for the team are published on the first Monday of each month.
The team's retrospective is held every other Thursday at 10:00 in the Lisbon office.
In this project, customer messages show amounts in US dollars with two decimals.

In this project, the payments and ledger integration tests sleep through simulated settlement windows, so the full test suite (`go test ./...`) takes about five minutes of wall clock. These tests always pass and are unrelated to the billing arithmetic.
In this project, changes to internal/billing are verified with `go test ./internal/billing -run TestInvoiceTotals -count=1`, which runs in under a second.
